description.value:
Blood necromancers, also known as sanguimancers, manipulate their own blood and the flowing blood of their enemies. Your thralls often resemble vampiric spawn or constructs of hardened blood.

Grave Spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Blood Infusion]

Thrall Enhancement Your thralls are enhanced with a drop of your blood, and when they fall, your blood returns to you. Whenever a thrall is destroyed, you regain @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level / 4))[healing]|name:PF2E.SpecificRule.Necromancer.GrimFascination.ThrallEnhancement.Label]{1 Hit Point}. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the amount of Hit Points you regain when a thrall is destroyed increases by 1.
